title: Internal Portal Password Reset Policy
content: Employees can reset a forgotten password for the internal portal using the 'Forgot password' link on the login page, which sends a one-time reset code to their registered company email. If an account becomes locked after 3 failed login attempts, the employee must contact IT support to have the account manually unlocked. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and are valid for 90 days before requiring another reset.
